name: Big River (Meramec basin) — Bootleg Access to Brown's Ford Access
blurb: Big River (Meramec basin) in Missouri: sections between public Missouri Department of Conservation accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Bootleg Access: approximate area only. Take-out Leadwood Access: approximate area only. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).

putInAccess.sourceName: Missouri Department of Conservation — Bootleg Access (area page)
putInAccess.note: Public river access is documented by Missouri Department of Conservation — Bootleg Access (area page). The coordinate is MDC Conservation Area centroids (Discover Nature atlas) — area centroid; approximate area, not the exact launch. Why not exact: the MDC record is a conservation-area centroid, not a launch feature.
putInAccess.directions: From Potosi, take Highway 21 south 10 miles to Big River.
